components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same last name and address) that opted in via sharesHousehold.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A1B0C
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Numeric level from 1 to 3 set on creation - starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or UNKNOWN when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: EMAIL when an email is present, otherwise PHONE.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: Age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate - MINOR (under 18), ADULT (18-64) or SENIOR (65+). Absent when birthDate is not set.
              type: string
              enum: [MINOR, ADULT, SENIOR]
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false

## What I changed

The soft-duplicate rule: a new owner sharing an existing owner's `lastName` + `postcode` but with a different `telephone` is still created, and returns `possibleDuplicate: true` / `possibleDuplicateOf: <matching id>`.

I added the behavior as a small, self-contained unit rather than growing any existing method:

1. **`PossibleDuplicates.java`** (new) — a tiny stateless helper (mirroring the existing `Namesakes`/`IdentityKey` idioms) whose `matchId(...)` returns the earliest matching owner's id, or `null`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a `possibleDuplicateOf` column with getter/setter plus a derived `isPossibleDuplicate()` (so MapStruct auto-maps both DTO fields — no mapper edit needed).

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — a single line: `owner.setPossibleDuplicateOf(PossibleDuplicates.matchId(owner, existingOwners))`, placed after the hard-duplicate check so it only runs when the owner is actually created.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — two new read-only `Owner` schema fields (`possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`) so the generated DTO exposes them.

5. **`schema.sql` / `data.sql`** (hsqldb, the test DB) — added the `possible_duplicate_of` column at the end of the `owners` table and extended the positional seed inserts.

## Keeping structural impact low
- Only **one line** was added to the large `OwnerRestControllerV1` (the high-`WMC_other` class), so it pays that class's context cost just once for one line.
- New logic lives in a fresh class with zero surrounding complexity.
- I avoided touching `OwnerMapper` entirely by relying on MapStruct name-based auto-mapping (`isPossibleDuplicate()` + `getPossibleDuplicateOf()`).
- Only the hsqldb DB scripts were updated — consistent with the repo, where the other DB variants are already not kept in sync with these derived columns.

## What I changed

The soft-duplicate rule: a new owner sharing an existing owner's `lastName` + `postcode` but with a different `telephone` is still created, and returns `possibleDuplicate: true` / `possibleDuplicateOf: <matching id>`.

I added the behavior as a small, self-contained unit rather than growing any existing method:

1. **`PossibleDuplicates.java`** (new) — a tiny stateless helper (mirroring the existing `Namesakes`/`IdentityKey` idioms) whose `matchId(...)` returns the earliest matching owner's id, or `null`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a `possibleDuplicateOf` column with getter/setter plus a derived `isPossibleDuplicate()` (so MapStruct auto-maps both DTO fields — no mapper edit needed).

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — a single line: `owner.setPossibleDuplicateOf(PossibleDuplicates.matchId(owner, existingOwners))`, placed after the hard-duplicate check so it only runs when the owner is actually created.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — two new read-only `Owner` schema fields (`possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`) so the generated DTO exposes them.

5. **`schema.sql` / `data.sql`** (hsqldb, the test DB) — added the `possible_duplicate_of` column at the end of the `owners` table and extended the positional seed inserts.

## Keeping structural impact low
- Only **one line** was added to the large `OwnerRestControllerV1` (the high-`WMC_other` class), so it pays that class's context cost just once for one line.
- New logic lives in a fresh class with zero surrounding complexity.
- I avoided touching `OwnerMapper` entirely by relying on MapStruct name-based auto-mapping (`isPossibleDuplicate()` + `getPossibleDuplicateOf()`).
- Only the hsqldb DB scripts were updated — consistent with the repo, where the other DB variants are already not kept in sync with these derived columns.
